screenshot.downscaleCaption: Captures from scaled displays (125 %, 150 %, 200 % and so on) are saved at their 100 % size, which makes smaller files.
screenshot.loupeZoomOptionCaption: Hold Alt to temporarily use the other mode.
screenshot.scrollingCaptureProgressHUD: Scroll with your mouse or touchpad. Press Enter or choose Done.
screenshot.scrollingCaptureCaption: Choose an area, scroll with your mouse or touchpad, then press Enter or Done to join it.
win.capture.hideOwnWindowsCaption: Keeps this app's own windows, such as Settings and pinned screenshots, out of captures and window picking.
win.capture.pinClickThroughHint: Clicks now go through the picture. Alt-click it to use it again.
win.capture.ocrUnavailableTitle: Text recognition needs a language pack
win.capture.ocrUnavailableBody: Windows has no text recognition (OCR) language installed. Add a language with “Optical character recognition” in Settings › Time & language › Language & region.
win.capture.ocrLanguagesCaption: Windows recognizes text in the languages whose OCR pack is installed. Add more in Language & region.
win.capture.autoScrollTooltip: Scrolls the area for you and finishes when the page stops moving.
win.capture.clearHistoryMessage: Screenshots kept only in the history are deleted. Saved files and recordings stay where they are.
win.capture.printScreenCaption: Print Screen opens the capture instead of the Snipping Tool while the app runs. Windows gets the key back when this is off or the app quits.
